notes_for_editor: Brief's 1934 build date has no source; NHLR gives 1935, so a correction is proposed. Height 24.4 m matches the Register's 80 feet. The 2017 visit report is the only condition and staffing evidence and is nine years old; it was written by an outside visitor, not the Bureau. The 2026 activity plan reports steps work in 2021 with completion expected in 2026, but does not say whether it is finished, so current condition is unconfirmed. Access is recorded as restricted from the 2017 fencing alone; the editor should confirm current access with the Bureau. Pocono Record articles (2000, 2011) returned 403 and were not used; a Times Leader 2002 item on Dixon Miller has no body text in the cache and is not used.
